text:
maria_marketing: Quick flag  we've observed a small but persistent pile of leads stuck in 'enriching' after HubSpot enrichment timeouts. They remain claimed and block owner rotation for hours. Not a huge fraction (~1.8%) but it accumulates and skews SLAs. Anyone seen this before?

jason_salesops: Yep saw this last week on campaign X. We lost ~40 leads to stale claims. We should avoid owners holding slots when enrichment hangs. Can we add a failsafe? :thinking_face:

li_engineering: I can add a heartbeat job to detect stuck enrichments. Plan: probe every 5m, criteria: enrich_status==failed OR (enrich_pending && claim_age > 15m). If criteria hit, move to a dead-letter queue (DLQ) and optionally push to SDR fallback.

emma_revops: DLQ needs a triage flow and Slack alert. Suggest DLQ label "manual-enrich-needed" and a small Slack digest to #marketing-inbound with lead id, campaign, and short reason. SDRs will own triage if owner OOO or claim older than 30m.

maria_marketing: Also for round-robin, can we shorten claim TTL for inbound to 15m and add claim-jitter to spread bursts? Right now TTL=60m so owners block slots during enrich retries.

jason_salesops: Agreed. Proposal: inbound_claim_ttl = 15m, claim_jitter = uniform(0,90s), immediate fallback if enrich_retries >=2. That should free slots faster.

li_engineering: Edge-case: owner may be on PTO. We already sync an out_of_office flag from calendar daily. If owner_out_of_office==true then route to sdr_pool immediately instead of reassigning. Good catch.

li_engineering: Rough pseudo: 
for lead in HS.query("enrich_status:pending OR enrich_status:failed AND claim_time < now - 15m"):
    if lead.enrich_retries >= 2 or now - lead.claim_time > 15m:
        if lead.owner_out_of_office:
            move_to_queue(lead, "sdr_fallback")
        else:
            set_property(lead, "manual_enrich_needed", "true")
            move_to_dlq(lead)
            post_slack("#marketing-inbound", f"Lead {lead.id} -> DLQ: enrich_failed, owner={lead.owner}")

emma_revops: I'll draft the HubSpot workflow change: when manual_enrich_needed==true then clear owner after 30m and set enrichment_workflow_flag. Also add a Salesforce sync that tags SF with enrichment_issue so AE knows. I'll attach the RFC with acceptance criteria + playbook for SDRs. ETA tomorrow EOD.

maria_marketing: Priority list: 1) heartbeat probe (5m) + DLQ + Slack digest, 2) adjust claim TTL to 15m + add jitter, 3) HS workflow to clear owner after 30m and tag manual_enrich_needed, 4) SDR playbook and SF sync.

jason_salesops: I'll run a small-canary test on staging traffic after Li's probe lands. If DLQ behaves, we flip to prod. Also will monitor claim-occupancy metric and SLA (time_to_first_touch).

ops-bot: job created: inbound-enrich-heartbeat -> cron: */5 * * * * (staging).

maria_marketing: Thanks. Can we have a 15m sync after Emma posts RFC? I want to walk through SDR playbook and confirm message copy for Slack digest. I'll schedule. :calendar:
